name: monorepo-root
description: Workspace root. Product naming lives in packages/engine/src/brand.ts.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/engine && npm run build -w packages/cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/engine && npm run build -w packages/engine && npm run typecheck -w packages/cli
scripts.test: npm run build && npm test -w packages/engine -w packages/cli
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm test -w apps/api -w packages/skills && npm run test:unit -w apps/web
